hero.headline: headshots that open doors
hero.subtitle: Make your first impression count. Transform everyday selfies into standout headshots, personalized to you and ready in minutes.

story.paragraph1: We've forgotten the art of showing up at our best. We snap a selfie, tweak the angle, and hope it's enough to make a mark. In a world that scrolls fast and judges faster, you need a photo that speaks—clearly, confidently, and with purpose.
story.paragraph2: Primeshot transforms your everyday photos into premium headshots, brimming with style and personality. No stiff poses. No awkward photoshoots. Just authentic, scroll-stopping portraits delivered in minutes.
story.callToAction: Shine as you are—with bold ambition.
